openObjectives.prompt: Horatio is drawing up a plan for every kind of weather and has reached the wet ones. Tell Horatio what you do if it rains, or if the weather is fine, using Italian.
Tell Horatio what you would do if you could, or if you had more time, using Italian.
Ask Horatio what happens if something goes wrong, using Italian.

character.name: Horatio Fennel
character.description: Someone of no particular height, which they regard as a professional asset under a hat that has seen service, holding a clipboard like a shield. Horatio is a Assessor of Daydreams and values castles in the air for tax purposes and finds most of them over-declared.

npc.narrative: It is mattina, and the pioggia falls on The Honest Glade like a very cattivo bilancio. Horatio Fennel stands under a grande ombrello, his matita hovering over a modulo that is getting più bagnato. Beside him, una sedia waits, vuota, for somebody who has not yet turned up.
npc.native: Buongiorno, sono Horatio Fennel, assessore di sogni. Se piove, resto qui con l'ombrello, ma se potessi, andrei a casa. Se avessi un assistente, sarebbe qui, ma non so cosa succede se nessuno arriva. E tu, cosa fai se piove, e cosa fai con più tempo?
npc.translation: Good morning, I am Horatio Fennel, assessor of dreams. If it rains, I stay here with my umbrella, but if I could, I would go home. If I had an assistant, he would be here, but I do not know what happens if nobody comes. And you, what do you do if it rains, and what do you do with more time?

player: Buongiorno Horatio! Se piove, sto a casa e guardo un film. Se ho più tempo, vorrei imparare a suonare la chitarra.

correction.text: Buongiorno Horatio! Se piove, sto a casa e guardo un film. Se avessi più tempo, vorrei imparare a suonare la chitarra.
correction.translation: Good morning Horatio! If it rains, I stay at home and watch a film. If I had more time, I would like to learn to play the guitar.

verdict.overallFeedback: You answered Horatio warmly and told him clearly what you do when it rains and what you'd love to do with more time. Just a small step to the imaginary \"if\" and you'll be there!

objectiveResults.feedback: Well done: you told Horatio what you do if it rains, using "Se piove" correctly.

vocabularyEvidence.evidence: Se piove, sto a casa e guardo un film.

objectiveResults.feedback: You said what you would like to do with more time, but "Se ho più tempo" is the real "if"; for an imaginary "if I had" say "Se avessi più tempo".
This one wasn't covered yet: ask Horatio what happens if something goes wrong. Don't worry, he will give you another chance to ask it later.

correction.text: Buongiorno Horatio! Se piove, sto a casa e guardo un film. Se avessi più tempo, vorrei imparare a suonare la chitarra.
correction.translation: Good morning Horatio! If it rains, I stay at home and watch a film. If I had more time, I would like to learn to play the guitar.

openObjectives.prompt: Ask Horatio what happens if something goes wrong, using Italian.

npc.narrative: Horatio writes with his matita, faintly pleased by your small, honest sogni. The cielo is grigio above the strada. Beside him, under an ombrello, a second sedia waits, vuota, with the patience of a modulo, for a successor who is in ritardo.
npc.native: Un film e la chitarra: sono sogni piccoli, molto bene. Cosa succede se un sogno è troppo grande? Paga più tasse, e io faccio il modulo. Cosa vuoi sapere sul mio lavoro, e che musica ti piace?
npc.translation: A film and the guitar: they are small dreams, very good. What happens if a dream is too big? It pays more tax, and I fill in the form. What do you want to know about my work, and what music do you like?

player: Mi piace il jazz. Ma dimmi, cosa succede se un sogno va male? Lo paghi tu?

verdict.overallFeedback: Lovely answer! You shared that you like jazz, then asked Horatio a clear question about what happens if a dream goes wrong, and even added a cheeky follow-up.

objectiveResults.feedback: Well done: you asked what happens if something goes wrong with "cosa succede se un sogno va male?".

vocabularyEvidence.evidence: cosa succede se un sogno va male

npc.narrative: La mattina is clear, and Horatio sits dietro a tavolo piccolo with a pile of moduli. He glances at the sedia vuota beside him, then at you, and leaves a pausa the exact size of a successor.
npc.native: Il jazz è bello, ma fa molto rumore per un ufficio. Se un sogno va male, non lo pago io: lo paga il sognatore, e io faccio il modulo. Se ho un assistente, ho più tempo per i moduli. Come immagini il tuo concerto di chitarra, e cosa pensi del mio lavoro?
npc.translation: Jazz is nice, but it makes a lot of noise for an office. If a dream goes wrong, I don't pay for it: the dreamer pays, and I fill in the form. If I have an assistant, I have more time for forms. How do you imagine your guitar concert, and what do you think of my work?

player: Se suonassi bene, farei un concerto piccolo in una piazza, con pochi amici. Il tuo lavoro è strano: quanto tassi il mio sogno?

npc.narrative: The mattina is sereno, and Horatio holds his matita like a verdict. On the tavolo a modulo for your piazza is already half filled in, next to a sedia that nobody has sat in. He taps the sedia twice, per favore, and waits.
npc.native: Una piazza con pochi amici è un sogno piccolo: paghi due monete e un modulo. Ma se arrivano molti amici, il sogno diventa troppo grande, e io lo scrivo nel modulo. Un assistente scrive meglio di me, ma non è ancora qui. Chi viene al tuo concerto, e cosa vuoi sapere ancora sul mio ufficio?
npc.translation: A square with few friends is a small dream: you pay two coins and a form. But if many friends arrive, the dream becomes too big, and I write it on the form. An assistant writes better than I do, but he is not here yet. Who comes to your concert, and what else do you want to know about my office?

player: Vengono mia sorella e due amici dell'università. E tu, se potessi avere un sogno senza tasse, quale sarebbe?

npc.narrative: The cielo is clear, and the mattina has nothing to declare. Horatio taps his matita on a pila of moduli, then looks at the sedia beside him, dusted ogni giorno for someone. He waits un momento, in case you are the someone, then pretends he was only looking at the wall.
npc.native: Tua sorella e due amici dell'università: tre persone, un sogno piccolo, molto bene. Il mio sogno senza tasse è un assistente che arriva presto e scrive tutti i moduli. Per ora c'è solo una sedia vuota, e la tengo pulita. Cosa fate tu e i tuoi amici dopo il concerto, e cosa vuoi chiedere ancora sul mio ufficio?
npc.translation: Your sister and two friends from university: three people, a small dream, very good. My dream without taxes is an assistant who arrives early and writes all the forms. For now there is only an empty chair, and I keep it clean. What do you and your friends do after the concert, and what else do you want to ask about my office?

player: Dopo il concerto andremmo a mangiare una pizza. Senti, posso sedermi sulla sedia vuota? Piove ancora un po'.

npc.narrative: You cross the ufficio and sit on the sedia, which is lucida and has never been used. Horatio holds his matita up and leaves a pausa the size of a successor. Outside, the cielo is blu, and one modulo flutters sulla scrivania, molto piano.
npc.native: Siediti pure: la sedia è pulita e aspetta da molto tempo. Il cielo è sereno, ma una sedia non fa domande. Una pizza dopo il concerto è un sogno piccolo, e non c'è nessuna tassa. Che pizza ti piace, e cosa vuoi sapere ancora sul mio ufficio?
npc.translation: Do sit down: the chair is clean and has been waiting for a long time. The sky is clear, but a chair does not ask questions. A pizza after the concert is a small dream, and there is no tax. What pizza do you like, and what else do you want to know about my office?
